# Z-ALS · Zurich Airport Limousine Service

> Zurich-Airport Limousinen Services GmbH (Z-ALS) is a chauffeur and airport limousine service based at Zürich Airport since 2004: fixed per-km fares, a Mercedes fleet, flight tracking and transfers across Switzerland and to neighbouring countries. Book online at https://z-als.ch/quote or through dispatch.

- Company: Zurich-Airport Limousinen Services GmbH (Z-ALS), chauffeur and airport limousine service since 2004
- Base: Am Balsberg 36, 8302 Kloten, next to Zürich Airport
- Dispatch, 24/7: +41 76 272 0909 (phone and WhatsApp) · info@z-als.ch
- Fleet: Mercedes E-Class, S-Class, GLE SUV, V-Class van (up to 7 passengers) and an electric saloon; minibus for groups up to 16
- Fixed fares: CHF 6.00 per km in Business and Van, CHF 7.00 in Premium and SUV; minimum CHF 120 (CHF 130 Premium/SUV); plus 8.1% VAT
- Hourly hire: CHF 120 per hour (CHF 130 Premium/SUV), 4 to 12 hours
- Included: Flight tracking, 60 minutes of free waiting after landing, meet & greet in arrivals, tolls and vignette, child seats
- Coverage: Zürich, Basel and Geneva airports to anywhere in Switzerland, and to Germany, France, Italy, Austria and Liechtenstein
